# The unofficial MusicXML test suite

Reinhold Kainhofer's test suite, as kept in LilyPond's repository
(`input/regression/musicxml`, fetched 2026-11-21): the `.xml` and `.mxl` files only. It is under
the MIT licence, in `LICENSE` beside this file. Composer's tests import every file, check that the
result draws and adds up, and send it back through MusicXML.
